title: Two Famous Landmarks
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, France. It is very tall. Many people visit it every year. Many people take photos there.

The Great Wall of China is very long. It is old. Many tourists walk on it. It is a famous place.

questions.text: What do many tourists do on the Great Wall?
What can we say about the Eiffel Tower?
options: It is a famous and popular place

questions.text: What can we say about the Great Wall?
options: It is a place many people want to see

vocabulary.definition: having a large height from bottom to top
to go to a place to see it
people who travel to see other places

paragraph_translations: A Torre Eiffel fica em Paris, na França. Ela é muito alta. Muitas pessoas a visitam todos os anos. Muitas pessoas tiram fotos ali.
A Muralha da China é muito longa. Ela é antiga. Muitos turistas andam sobre ela. É um lugar famoso.
